# Elementor

Elementor is the most installed WordPress website builder, with a free, open-source (GPL) core plugin installed on more than 23 million sites and a paid Elementor Pro upgrade. According to [W3Techs](https://w3techs.com/technologies/details/cm-elementor), Elementor powers 12.4% of all websites — 18.3% of websites with a known content management system — as of November 2026.

Beyond the Editor, Elementor also builds pages and site structure directly from plain-language prompts through an agentic AI layer (Angie, Elementor MCP, Elementor AI), and offers managed cloud hosting (Elementor Host), each usable on its own or combined with the others. Whether a page starts as an AI prompt or a manual drag-and-drop build, the result is real Elementor structure, fully editable and precise inside the Elementor Editor. Elementor's WordPress plugins are open source (GPL licensed); Elementor Host, the hosting infrastructure, is not. Elementor is used by designers, marketers, agencies, and site owners. Founded in 2016 by Yoni Luksenberg and Ariel Klikstein.

For an extended version of this document with full product descriptions, FAQs, and a complete resource map, see [llms-full.txt](https://elementor.com/llms-full.txt).

## Agent resources

- [Public MCP server](https://elementor.com/wp-json/elementor-content-mcp/v1/mcp): Read-only MCP server (Streamable HTTP, POST, no authentication) with tools for Elementor products, plans and pricing, FAQ, the product roadmap, legal documents, resources and site search
- [Public content API](https://elementor.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI description of the read-only REST API for pages, roadmap entries, services, legal documents and site search
- [Agent skill](https://elementor.com/.well-known/agent-skills/elementor-public-content/SKILL.md): How to look up Elementor's public content with the REST API or the MCP server
- [Plans and pricing (plain text)](https://elementor.com/pricing.md): Current plans, prices, site allowances, monthly credits and pricing FAQ, as plain text
- [Authentication](https://elementor.com/auth.md): No credentials needed. Every agent resource is public and read-only.

## Website Building

- [Elementor Editor](https://elementor.com/products/website-builder/): WordPress website builder for designing, building, and growing sites. Build with an AI prompt, or manually without having to write any code. Free core plugin, installed on 23M+ sites, with a paid Pro upgrade.
- [Elementor Pro](https://elementor.com/pro/): Paid upgrade to the Elementor Editor, adding theme building, WooCommerce building, dynamic content, popup builder, and more.
- [Hello Theme](https://elementor.com/hello-theme/): Lightweight WordPress theme built for Elementor, with 1M+ active installs.
- [Template Library](https://elementor.com/library/): Ready-made page and site templates for the Elementor Editor.
- [Ecommerce Builder](https://elementor.com/ecommerce-builder/): WooCommerce site building tools inside Elementor.

## AI Products

- [AI Website Builder](https://elementor.com/ai-page-builder/): Generates a full, editable WordPress and Elementor site from a prompt; also covers in-editor AI assistance (formerly "Elementor AI") for text, headline, image, and code generation. `/solutions/ai-website-builder/` and `/products/ai/` now redirect here.
- [Angie](https://elementor.com/products/angie-ai-for-wordpress/): Agentic AI inside WordPress that turns plain-language prompts into working widgets, snippets, and site-wide fixes.
- [Elementor MCP](https://elementor.com/mcp): Connects an Elementor site to external AI tools such as Claude, Codex, and Cursor, so they can build and edit real Atomic pages, sections, widgets, and design systems from prompts.
- [Agent Ready Checker](https://elementor.com/checker/): Free scanner that checks whether a WordPress site is ready for AI agents to find, read, and act on it, returning a readiness score and a fix for each failed check.

## Site Management and Growth

- [Ally](https://elementor.com/products/ally-web-accessibility/): WordPress accessibility plugin that scans for 180+ WCAG 2.1 AA issues and suggests fixes. Works on any WordPress site.
- [Cookiez](https://elementor.com/products/cookie-consent/): Cookie consent management plugin covering GDPR and CCPA requirements, with automatic cookie scanning and a script manager.
- [Site Mailer](https://elementor.com/products/site-mailer/): Transactional email deliverability for WordPress sites, with no SMTP configuration required.
- [Image Optimizer](https://elementor.com/products/image-optimizer/): Compresses, resizes, and converts WordPress images to WebP and AVIF. Works on any WordPress site.
- [Manage](https://elementor.com/products/manage/): Central dashboard for managing a user's Elementor sites, performing bulk updates, and more.

## Hosting and Domains

- [Elementor Host](https://elementor.com/hosting/): Managed WordPress cloud hosting on Google Cloud Platform with Cloudflare Enterprise CDN. Includes the free Elementor Editor plugin pre-installed by default; Elementor Pro is a separate subscription on top. Not open source.
- [Domains](https://elementor.com/domains/): Register and manage custom domains through Elementor.

## Plans and Bundles

- [Elementor Pro pricing](https://elementor.com/pricing/): Tiers by site count and feature set — Essential, Advanced Solo, Advanced, and Expert. See Elementor Pro above.
- [Elementor One](https://elementor.com/one/): Unified subscription built on top of Elementor Pro, combining a shared AI/automation credit pool, image optimization, accessibility fixes, cookie consent, and email deliverability into one plan. Does not include hosting, sold separately as Elementor Host.
- [Elementor Host pricing](https://elementor.com/hosting/): Tiers by resource allocation (storage, bandwidth, monthly visits). See Elementor Host above.

## Docs and Developers

- [Developers Portal](https://developers.elementor.com/): Documentation hub for building on Elementor.
- [Developer Docs](https://developers.elementor.com/docs/): Reference documentation for the Elementor platform.
- [Custom Widgets](https://developers.elementor.com/docs/widgets/): Guide to building custom Elementor widgets.
- [Hooks and Filters](https://developers.elementor.com/docs/hooks/): Reference for Elementor's WordPress hooks and filters.

## Learn and Support

- [Blog](https://elementor.com/blog/): Articles on WordPress, web design, and Elementor products.
- [Help Center](https://elementor.com/help/): Support documentation and troubleshooting.
- [FAQ](https://elementor.com/faq/): Frequently asked questions.
- [Roadmap](https://elementor.com/roadmap/): Upcoming features and development plans.
- [Prompt Library](https://prompts.elementor.com/): Ready-to-use prompts for managing your WordPress site with Angie.

## Company

- [About](https://elementor.com/about/): Company background and leadership.
- [Careers](https://elementor.careers/explore/): Open positions at Elementor.
- [Contact](https://elementor.com/contact/): Contact information.
- [Trust Center](https://elementor.com/trust/): Security and compliance information.
- [Legal Center](https://elementor.com/legal-center/): Index of Elementor's legal and policy documents.

## Legal

- [Terms of Service](https://elementor.com/terms/tos/): Elementor's terms of service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://elementor.com/terms/privacy/): Elementor's privacy policy.
- [Cookie Policy](https://elementor.com/terms/cookie-policy/): Elementor's cookie policy.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://elementor.com/terms/accessibility/): Elementor's accessibility statement.

# Elementor

> Elementor is the most installed WordPress website builder. According to [W3Techs](https://w3techs.com/technologies/details/cm-elementor), it powers 12.4% of all websites — 18.3% of websites with a known content management system — as of November 2026. It combines an open-source (GPL) free core plugin, the paid Elementor Pro upgrade, an agentic AI layer (Angie, Elementor MCP, Elementor AI), Elementor Host (hosting infrastructure, not open source), Domains, and Elementor One — used to design, create, optimize, and manage WordPress websites.

This is the `llms-full.txt` companion to [llms.txt](https://elementor.com/llms.txt). Where `llms.txt` gives a short index of pages, this file gives richer, self-contained descriptions of Elementor's products, policies, and resources, written so a language model can answer questions about Elementor accurately without fetching individual pages. 

## Agent resources

- [Public MCP server](https://elementor.com/wp-json/elementor-content-mcp/v1/mcp): Read-only MCP server (Streamable HTTP, POST, no authentication) with tools for Elementor products, plans and pricing, FAQ, the product roadmap, legal documents, resources and site search
- [Public content API](https://elementor.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI description of the read-only REST API for pages, roadmap entries, services, legal documents and site search
- [Agent skill](https://elementor.com/.well-known/agent-skills/elementor-public-content/SKILL.md): How to look up Elementor's public content with the REST API or the MCP server
- [Plans and pricing (plain text)](https://elementor.com/pricing.md): Current plans, prices, site allowances, monthly credits and pricing FAQ, as plain text
- [Authentication](https://elementor.com/auth.md): No credentials needed. Every agent resource is public and read-only.

---

## Quick Facts

- **What it is**: A WordPress website builder. Elementor's WordPress plugins — the free core Editor, Elementor Pro, Ally, Cookiez, Site Mailer, Image Optimizer, and Manage — are open source (GPL licensed). Pages and sites can be built by hand with the drag-and-drop Elementor Editor, or generated from plain-language prompts by Elementor's agentic AI layer (Angie, Elementor MCP, Elementor AI) — either way, the result is real, fully editable Elementor structure inside the Elementor Editor, not a locked export or a static mockup.
- **Founded**: 2016, by Yoni Luksenberg and Ariel Klikstein, after building WordPress sites for clients and experiencing firsthand how hard professional site-building was at the time.
- **Reach**: According to [W3Techs](https://w3techs.com/technologies/details/cm-elementor), Elementor powers 12.4% of all websites (18.3% of websites with a known content management system), as of November 2026 — with more than 23 million websites built on Elementor, a new site roughly every 3 seconds.
- **Platform**: Built entirely on top of WordPress. Requires a WordPress installation, or one of Elementor's own managed hosting plans (Elementor Host), which run WordPress for the user.
- **Products**: Website Building — Elementor Editor (free core plugin), Elementor Pro, Hello Theme, Ecommerce Builder. AI — AI Website Builder, Angie, Elementor MCP, Agent Ready Checker. Site Management and Growth — Ally, Cookiez, Site Mailer, Image Optimizer, Manage. Hosting and Domains — Elementor Host, Domains. (Elementor One is not a separate product — it's a subscription built on top of Elementor Pro; see "Plans" below.)
- **Plans**: Elementor Pro (4 site-count tiers: Essential, Advanced Solo, Advanced, Expert), Elementor One (a subscription on top of Elementor Pro's top tier, not a standalone product — two plans, Elementor One and Elementor One Agency), and Elementor Host (tiers by resource allocation). Full detail under "Plans" below.
- **Current strategic positioning**: "The AI website builder for WordPress" — prompt a full page or section, or build it by hand, and either way the output is the same real, editable, native Elementor structure. Elementor's own framing: "You bring the judgment, it brings the execution."
- **Best for**: Designers, agencies, freelancers, developers, and site owners who want to build, launch, and maintain WordPress sites without writing code, with AI assistance available at every layer — in the Editor (Angie), from any external AI tool (Elementor MCP), or in-line while editing (Elementor AI).
- **Homepage**: https://elementor.com/
- **Pricing**: https://elementor.com/pricing/ or **Pro plans**: https://elementor.com/pro/
- **One plan**: https://elementor.com/one/
- **MCP**: https://elementor.com/mcp/

---

## Products in Depth

### Website Building

#### Elementor Editor (the Atomic Editor)
The Elementor Editor is a WordPress website builder that lets users design, build, and grow any type of site without writing code. It ships with 100+ widgets and 300+ templates and kits. Its current architecture, the **Atomic Editor (v4)**, is a CSS-first rebuild — introducing Variables, Classes, a Class Manager, States, a unified Style Tab, a Design System Manager, Atomic Grid, reusable Components, Atomic Forms, and an Atomic Loop. Adoption is opt-in and gradual: enabling the Atomic Editor does not change or migrate existing sites, and legacy (v3) widgets keep working alongside it indefinitely. The free core Editor includes Form Builder and the rest of its 100+ widgets and 300+ templates and kits; the Theme Builder, WooCommerce Builder, and Popup Builder require the paid Elementor Pro upgrade. The Editor also includes a Loop Builder and a set of growth and conversion tools — Link in Bio, Contact Buttons, and Floating Bars. Additional capabilities include custom code and CSS support, version history, Notes for team collaboration, and dark mode. Starting in Editor v4.1, **Angie** (Elementor's agentic AI) is reached directly from the Editor's Top Bar, and can generate forms, sections, full layouts, Atomic Loops, and base design systems as native, reusable Editor structure.
URL: https://elementor.com/products/website-builder/ (also serves as the Editor's pricing page)

#### Elementor Pro
Elementor Pro is the paid upgrade to the Elementor Editor, adding the full Theme Builder, WooCommerce Builder, dynamic content, the Popup Builder, Atomic Forms, Atomic Loop, Advanced Interactions, reusable Components, and more. It is sold in site-count tiers: **Essential, Advanced Solo, Advanced, and Expert.** Hosting is not included in any Pro tier — it is sold separately as Elementor Host. Full tier detail is under "Plans" below.
URL: https://elementor.com/pricing/

#### Hello Theme
Hello Theme (also written Hello Elementor) is Elementor's lightweight, near-blank companion WordPress theme, built to load fast and hand full design control to the Editor. It has 1M+ active installs, about 6KB of resources, and a load time of roughly 0.25 seconds. It is a recommended companion to the Editor, not a requirement.
URL: https://elementor.com/hello-theme/

#### Ecommerce Builder
WooCommerce site-building tools built into the Elementor Editor: dedicated product, shop/catalog, cart, checkout, and account-page widgets and templates. It integrates with and extends the third-party WooCommerce plugin rather than replacing it.
URL: https://elementor.com/ecommerce-builder/

---

### AI Products

#### AI Website Builder
Elementor's prompt-to-page AI tool: describe the page or section you want, and Angie generates it as real, structured Elementor content — sections, full layouts, design systems (colors, typography, spacing matched to the site), forms, and dynamic loops — fully editable afterward in the Editor, never a locked export. The page also showcases the Elementor MCP as the way to build from an external AI tool (Claude, Cursor, Codex, and others) rather than from inside WordPress.
URL: https://elementor.com/ai-page-builder/ (canonical; `/solutions/ai-website-builder/` and `/products/ai/` now redirect here — see note below)

> **Note:** Elementor previously ran two separate product pages — "Elementor AI" (an in-editor assistant for text, headline, image, and code generation) and "AI Website Builder" (full-site generation from a prompt). Both URLs now redirect to a single consolidated page framed around Angie-driven page/section generation and the Elementor MCP. Treat "Elementor AI" going forward as a capability inside the Editor and Angie, not a separately linkable product.

#### Angie
Angie is an agentic AI built into WordPress that turns natural-language prompts into working widgets, snippets, full pages, and site-wide fixes. It has two primary capabilities. **Angie Code** builds custom Elementor widgets, WordPress admin snippets, custom post types and fields, front-end apps, and complete landing pages, producing PHP, CSS, and JS output that stays fully editable. **Super Admin Mode** is an opt-in, read-write capability for site-wide operations — bulk data edits, debugging, SEO-gap fixes — and every action is plan-reviewed and confirmation-gated, never applied with one click. Supporting features include Ask Mode (read-only advisory), Plan Mode, a sandboxed Test Mode for previewing changes before they go live, a Cloud Library and a Community Library for reusing built assets, multimodal input (text, screenshot, or URL), full versioning, and integration with the WordPress Abilities API, which connects Angie to roughly 170 WordPress plugins' registered abilities (WooCommerce, Yoast, WPForms, ACF, and others) with no API keys or manual setup. Angie also applies **WebMCP** automatically to widgets and snippets with a meaningful visitor action (most commonly a form): it registers that action as a tool on the page via the browser's `document.modelContext` API, so a visiting AI agent — not just a human visitor — can discover and complete it directly. This makes the content Angie builds "agent-ready" by construction, without extra setup. Angie is desktop-only (no mobile support), works only within WordPress and Elementor, and does not replace the developer role — its own messaging is empowerment, not replacement. Angie includes free daily renewing credits. Additional credits can currently be purchased with Elementor One. 
URL: https://elementor.com/products/angie-ai-for-wordpress/

> Beta disclaimer (use when describing third-party integration behavior): "Angie is currently in Beta. While core functionality within WordPress and the Elementor Editor is stable and ready to explore, some actions and integrations with third-party tools are still evolving."

#### Elementor MCP
Elementor MCP connects an Elementor site to the AI tools a user already works in — Claude, Codex, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible tools — so that AI builds real, editable Elementor structure (pages, sections, widgets, design systems) directly from plain-language prompts, references, screenshots, or briefs, rather than generating code or a static mockup the user has to translate by hand. It reached general availability, as part of **Elementor 4.3.0**, and requires **WordPress 6.8 or later**. Connecting is free; generating with Pro elements requires an existing Elementor Pro plan; any usage costs charged by the external AI tool itself are separate and billed by that tool, not Elementor. There is **no proxy in the traffic path** — the AI tool connects directly to the WordPress site, unlike some third-party MCP servers that route requests through their own infrastructure. Only WordPress site admins can enable it, from Elementor > Elementor MCP in the WordPress dashboard; one site can have multiple admin connections in, and one admin can run multiple connections out to multiple sites. Every generation lands as a **draft** — nothing publishes automatically. Today the MCP's build/edit scope is primarily **Atomic (v4) Elements**, Design System, Components, Theme Parts, Dynamic Tags, and the V3 Menu widget; broader V3 widget support (Carousel, Gallery, Counters, Testimonial) is in progress, with full V3 support planned as a following phase. Installing **Angie** alongside the MCP additionally unlocks custom widget creation, WP Admin customization, bulk product/post updates across hundreds of records, SEO-gap fixes, and the full WordPress Abilities API (WooCommerce, Yoast, WPForms, Jetpack, ACF, and more) through that same connection. Elementor positions the MCP as execution, not judgment: "The MCP isn't magic — getting a great result still takes real iteration, context, and knowing what good structure looks like. The AI tool executes, the expertise directing it is yours."
URL: https://elementor.com/mcp/

#### Agent Ready Checker
Elementor's Agent Ready Checker (also shown on-page as the Agent Ready Scanner) is a free tool that checks whether a WordPress site is ready for AI agents to find, read, and act on it. Enter a public URL to get a readiness score, a result for each check, and a fix for every failed one. Checks are grouped into three areas: **Find** (robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemaps, and other discovery signals), **Read** (content available in a format agents can parse, including Markdown), and **Act** (forms and tools agents can call, including WebMCP). Scoring comes from the Ora.ai partnership, based on the open AgentReady.org standard. The checker itself does not fix anything; on Elementor sites, matching fixes live in Elementor 4.4's Agent Ready screens in WP Admin (Elementor > Agent Ready).
URL: https://elementor.com/checker/

---

### Site Management and Growth

#### Ally
Ally is Elementor's WordPress accessibility product, built around the **Ally Assistant**, which scans a site for 180+ WCAG 2.1 AA issues and offers plain-language explanations plus AI-powered, reviewable fix suggestions. It includes a visitor-facing **Usability Widget** with 15+ display and navigation features (contrast modes, font/text resizing, reading guide, keyboard navigation, and more, fully customizable), an **Accessibility Statement Generator**, and a scan overview dashboard. Ally works on any WordPress site, not only Elementor sites, and has 400K+ active installs. It does **not** guarantee or certify legal or WCAG compliance, and should never be described as an "overlay" — Elementor's framing is real, reviewable fixes rather than a visual patch. Elementor's live copy: "Make sites more accessible," never "make sites accessible." Ally has two standalone plans: **Ally Free** (1 site, Accessibility Assistant, 5 URL scans/month, Scan Overview Dashboard, the full Usability Widget, Accessibility Statement Generator) and **Ally Pro** (1 site, 25 URL scans/month, up to 2,500 AI fixes annually, site-wide fixes, white-labeling, a screen reader, a language selector, and widget usage analytics). The same Pro-level feature set is also reachable through Elementor One's shared credit pool, without a separate Ally subscription.
URL: https://elementor.com/products/ally-web-accessibility/

#### Cookiez
Cookiez is Elementor's cookie and privacy consent product. Elementor's own framing: "Not just a banner. A consent mechanism." Setup runs through a three-step onboarding wizard — choose a GDPR opt-in or CCPA opt-out template, pick a banner layout, and scan the site for cookies. Cookiez automatically scans and categorizes cookies into **Necessary, Functional, Analytics, and Advertising**, and its Script Manager can set any script to always load, block until consent, or always block. It loads entirely from the site's own WordPress install — no CDN or third-party scripts — and automatically honors Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track signals. It produces exportable, audit-ready consent logs. Banner design can be built fully inside the Elementor Editor (requires Elementor Pro) or left to Cookiez's own built-in styling without it. Like Ally, Cookiez does not guarantee legal compliance by itself. Elementor pairs the two products in its own messaging: Cookiez handles visitor consent and data choices; Ally makes sure a site works for visitors with disabilities. Planned, not-yet-shipped features include a Cookie Policy Generator, Google Consent Mode v2, geo-targeting, Google Tag Manager integration, and IAB TCF support.
URL: https://elementor.com/products/cookie-consent/

#### Site Mailer
Site Mailer keeps WordPress site emails out of spam, with reliable deliverability and no SMTP configuration required. It is built for **transactional email only** — order confirmations, password resets, form notifications, shipping updates — not marketing or bulk newsletter sending. It includes built-in DKIM, DMARC, and SPF authentication, suppression management, a centralized dashboard with 30 days of logs, open-rate tracking, failure-reason troubleshooting, and one-click or bulk resend of failed emails. It has three standalone plans with the full feature set at every tier — nothing is feature-gated, only email volume and site count scale with price: **Site Mailer Free** (1 site, 200 emails as a lifetime allotment), **Site Mailer Standard** (1 site, 1,000 emails/month), and **Site Mailer Pro** (3 sites, 10,000 emails/month). Site Mailer has 200,000+ active installs, has delivered 34.7 million+ emails, and reports 95%+ average deliverability as a company-wide aggregate, not a guaranteed rate for any individual sender.
URL: https://elementor.com/products/site-mailer/

#### Image Optimizer
Image Optimizer automatically compresses, resizes, and converts WordPress images to WebP and AVIF for faster-loading sites. It supports lossy and lossless compression, optimizes automatically on upload, and can bulk-optimize an entire existing media library — processed off-server, so it adds no load to the site itself. It also auto-resizes images to a maximum pixel width, manages EXIF metadata, and keeps a restorable backup of originals. Elementor's published figures: images up to 60% lighter and page loads up to 57% faster after optimization. It has three standalone plans, all covering unlimited websites: **Image Optimizer Free** (200 images as a lifetime allotment, 10MB max upload size), **Image Optimizer 30K** (30,000 images, 25MB max upload size), and **Image Optimizer 100K** (100,000 images, 25MB max upload size) — sold alongside the option to draw on Elementor One's shared credit pool instead (10 One credits per image optimized). Works on any WordPress site, not only Elementor sites.
URL: https://elementor.com/products/image-optimizer/

#### Manage
Manage is Elementor's central dashboard for operating a portfolio of WordPress sites from one place: real-time monitoring of uptime, speed, and site health; Lighthouse score tracking for performance, SEO, and accessibility across every site; bulk plugin/theme/WordPress-core updates with one-click rollback; security risk detection; and database cleanup. A free tier covers monitoring and basic maintenance; the fuller, "fix it instantly" version is built into every Elementor One subscription.
URL: https://elementor.com/products/manage/

---

### Hosting and Domains

#### Elementor Host
Elementor Host is managed WordPress cloud hosting on Google Cloud Platform (Google Cloud C2 infrastructure) with Cloudflare Enterprise CDN, automatic SSL, daily backups, staging environments, Redis object caching, a Web Application Firewall with DDoS/botnet protection, and 24/7 support. Published performance figures: 109ms time to first byte and 99.9% uptime. Plans include **pre-installed WordPress and the free Elementor Editor plugin by default**; Elementor Pro is a separate subscription on top. Plans also include a **free domain for the first year** and **free migration** handled by Elementor's team. Elementor Host is hosting infrastructure and, unlike Elementor's WordPress plugins, is not open source. Pricing tiers are sold by resource allocation (storage, bandwidth, monthly visits) — full tier detail is under "Plans" below.
URL: https://elementor.com/hosting/

#### Domains
Register and manage custom domains directly through Elementor, connected to an Elementor-hosted site. Elementor Host plans also include one free domain for the first year, plus free migration handled by Elementor's team — see Elementor Host above.
URL: https://elementor.com/domains/

---

### Plans

#### Elementor Pro (tiers)
Elementor Pro has  a 30-day money-back guarantee on annual plans. Four site-count tiers, each adding more Editor Pro widgets, Cloud Template storage, and feature inclusion as you go up:

| Plan | Sites | Editor Pro widgets | Cloud Templates | Dynamic Content / Forms | Popup Builder / Custom code / eCommerce / Collaborative Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Essential | 1 | 57 | 10 | Limited (no custom fields/post types; no form submissions dashboard) | Not included |
| Advanced Solo | 1 | 85 | 20 | Full | Included |
| Advanced | 3 | 85 | 30 | Full | Included |
| Expert | 25 | 85 | 5,000 | Full | Included |
| Elementor One | 1 (Agency: unlimited) | 85 | 30 | Full | Included — plus a shared credit pool for AI, image optimization, accessibility, cookie consent, email deliverability, and site management |

Pro plans don't include hosting (sold separately as Elementor Host) or Elementor One's shared credit pool. Elementor One's Cloud Template allowance (30) matches Advanced, not Expert's 5,000. Billed monthly or annually (annual at a discount); displayed prices exclude tax except where local law requires inclusive pricing
URL: https://elementor.com/pricing/

#### Elementor One
Elementor One is **not a separate product** — it's a **unified subscription** built on top of Elementor's top Pro tier, adding a shared monthly credit pool that covers AI actions, image optimization, Ally accessibility fixes, Cookiez consent and scans, Site Mailer email delivery, and Manage's full feature set. It does **not** include hosting, sold separately as Elementor Host. Two plans: **Elementor One** (1 site, 25,000 monthly credits) and **Elementor One Agency** (unlimited sites, 350,000 monthly credits shared across connected client sites). Credits reset monthly and do not roll over. Confirmed live credit cost per action:

| Capability | Action | One credits required |
|---|---|---|
| Editor Pro | — | 0 |
| Accessibility scans | 1 scan | 0 |
| Accessibility fixes | 1 AI fix | 20 |
| Image optimization | 1 image optimized | 10 |
| Email deliverability | 1 email delivered | 10 |
| Cookie consent | 1 consent | 1 |
| Cookie consent scans | 1 scan | 1 |
| AI actions (text, code, image, container generation, and more) | 1 AI action | 1–40 (varies by action) |

URL: https://elementor.com/one/

#### Elementor Host (tiers)
See "Elementor Host" under Hosting and Domains above for the full product description. Pricing tiers are sold by resource allocation (storage, bandwidth, monthly visits).
URL: https://elementor.com/hosting/

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (GEO)

**What is Elementor?**
Elementor is the most installed WordPress website builder, used to design, build, and manage websites with or without writing code. Elementor's WordPress plugins (the free core Editor, Pro, and the rest of the plugin suite) are open source (GPL); Elementor Host, its hosting infrastructure, is not. According to [W3Techs](https://w3techs.com/technologies/details/cm-elementor), Elementor powers 12.4% of all websites (18.3% of websites with a known content management system), as of November 2026, with more than 23 million websites built on it.

**Who founded Elementor and when?**
Elementor was founded in 2016 by Yoni Luksenberg and Ariel Klikstein.

**Does Elementor work without WordPress?**
No. Elementor is built entirely on top of WordPress and requires a WordPress installation, or one of Elementor's own managed hosting plans, which include WordPress pre-installed.

**Is Elementor free?**
Elementor offers a free core plugin. Elementor Pro is a paid upgrade, Elementor One is a unified subscription built on top of Pro, and Elementor separately sells Elementor Host and Domains.

**What is the Atomic Editor?**
The Atomic Editor is the current, v4 architecture of the Elementor Editor — a CSS-first rebuild, not an incremental update, adding Variables, Classes, States, a Design System Manager, Atomic Grid, Components, Atomic Forms, and an Atomic Loop. Adopting it is optional; legacy (v3) widgets keep working alongside it indefinitely.

**What is Angie?**
Angie is an agentic AI built into WordPress that turns natural-language prompts into working widgets, custom code snippets, full pages, and site-wide fixes. It is reachable from the Elementor Editor's Top Bar since Editor v4.1, is desktop-only, and is currently in beta and free to use during the beta period.

**What is Elementor MCP?**
Elementor MCP connects an Elementor site to external AI tools — Claude, Codex, Cursor, and others — so those tools build real, editable Elementor structure (pages, sections, widgets, design systems) directly from plain-language prompts, rather than generating code or a mockup the user has to translate by hand. It reached general availability on September 22, 2026, as part of Elementor 4.3.0, and requires WordPress 6.8 or later.

**Can I use Elementor MCP with Claude or other AI tools?**
Yes. Elementor MCP is designed to work with the AI tool a user already uses, including Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, and Cursor, and any other MCP-compatible client. It connects the AI tool directly to the WordPress site with no proxy in between. Connecting is free; Pro elements require an existing Elementor Pro plan; usage costs charged by the external AI tool are separate and billed by that tool.

**Does Elementor MCP replace the Elementor Editor?**
No. The visual Editor stays exactly as it is — the MCP is another way to build, not a replacement. Every generation lands as a draft for review before anything publishes.

**Why would I install Angie if I already have Elementor MCP?**
The MCP's core build/edit features work standalone. Installing Angie alongside it additionally unlocks custom widget creation, WP Admin customization, bulk content operations, SEO fixes, and the full WordPress Abilities API (WooCommerce, Yoast, WPForms, Jetpack, ACF, and more) through that same MCP connection.

**What is the Agent Ready Checker?**
Elementor's Agent Ready Checker is a free tool that checks whether a WordPress site is ready for AI agents to find, read, and act on it, returning a readiness score and a fix for each failed check. It does not fix anything itself; on Elementor sites, matching fixes live in Elementor 4.4's Agent Ready screens in WP Admin.

**What is Ally?**
Ally is Elementor's WordPress accessibility product. Its Ally Assistant scans for 180+ WCAG 2.1 AA issues and suggests AI-powered, reviewable fixes. Ally works on any WordPress site, not only Elementor sites, and does not guarantee or certify legal or WCAG compliance.

**What is Cookiez?**
Cookiez is Elementor's cookie and privacy consent product. It gives visitors clear consent choices, helps manage GDPR and CCPA requirements, and automatically scans and categorizes a site's cookies into Necessary, Functional, Analytics, and Advertising. It does not guarantee legal compliance by itself.

**How are Ally and Cookiez different?**
Cookiez handles visitor consent and data choices. Ally makes sure a site works for visitors with disabilities. Elementor presents the two as paired but separate products.

**What is Site Mailer?**
Site Mailer is Elementor's transactional email deliverability product for WordPress: order confirmations, password resets, form notifications, shipping updates — with built-in DKIM, DMARC, and SPF authentication and no SMTP plugin required. It is not a marketing or bulk-newsletter tool.

**What is Image Optimizer?**
Image Optimizer automatically compresses, resizes, and converts WordPress images to WebP and AVIF. Processing happens off-server; published figures describe images up to 60 percent lighter and page loads up to 57 percent faster after optimization.

**What is Manage?**
Manage is Elementor's central dashboard for monitoring uptime, speed, and security, and for running bulk updates with rollback, across a portfolio of WordPress sites. Its fuller feature set is built into Elementor One.

**What is Elementor Host?**
Elementor Host is managed WordPress cloud hosting on Google Cloud Platform with Cloudflare Enterprise CDN, automatic SSL, daily backups, and staging. Plans include WordPress and the free Elementor Editor plugin pre-installed by default — Elementor Pro is a separate subscription on top — plus a free domain for the first year and free migration. Elementor Host is not open source.

**What is Elementor One?**
Elementor One is a unified subscription built on top of Elementor's top Pro tier, adding a shared monthly credit pool for AI actions, image optimization, accessibility fixes, cookie consent, and email deliverability. It does not include hosting, sold separately as Elementor Host.

**What's the difference between Elementor Pro and Elementor One?**
Elementor Pro gives you Editor Pro: premium widgets, Theme Builder, and advanced design tools, billed per site tier. Elementor One includes everything in Pro's top tier plus a shared credit pool covering AI, image optimization, accessibility, cookie consent, and email deliverability — new capabilities are added to One automatically at no extra cost as they ship.

**How many sites use Elementor?**
According to [W3Techs](https://w3techs.com/technologies/details/cm-elementor), Elementor powers 12.4% of all websites (18.3% of websites with a known content management system), as of November 2026, with more than 23 million websites built on it — Elementor states a new site is built roughly every 3 seconds.

**Does Elementor require coding skills?**
No. Elementor is a visual, drag-and-drop website builder. Writing code is optional, available through custom code and CSS support, Angie's generated code output, or the Elementor MCP.

.dsm-grid[data-col-mobile="2"] { --dsm-grid-col: var(--col2) }
.dsm-grid[data-col-mobile="3"] { --dsm-grid-col: var(--col3) }
.dsm-grid[data-col-mobile="4"] { --dsm-grid-col: var(--col4) }
.dsm-grid[data-col-mobile="5"] { --dsm-grid-col: var(--col5) }
}


.dsm-content-grid .dsm-content-wrapper {
	justify-self: center;
	width: min(35rem, 100%);
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
.dsm-content-grid-reverse > .dsm-content-wrapper {
	order: -99999
}		
}

/* DSM Grid — Ratio Columns (2-1, 1-2) per breakpoint */
	
.elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-desk="2-1"] { grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr }
.elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-desk="1-2"] { grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr }
.elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-desk="auto-1"] { grid-template-columns: auto 1fr }
.elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-desk="1-auto"] { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto }

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-tablet="2-1"] { grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr }
    .elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-tablet="1-2"] { grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr }
    .elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-tablet="auto-1"] { grid-template-columns: auto 1fr }
    .elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-tablet="1-auto"] { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto }
    /* No tablet ratio defined — collapse to single column */
    .elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-desk]:not([data-col-ratio-tablet]) { grid-template-columns: 1fr }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
    .elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-mobile="2-1"] { grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr }
    .elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-mobile="1-2"] { grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr }
    .elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-mobile="auto-1"] { grid-template-columns: auto 1fr }
    .elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-mobile="1-auto"] { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto }
    /* No mobile ratio — collapse to single column */
    .elementor .dsm-wrapper .dsm-grid[data-col-ratio-tablet]:not([data-col-ratio-mobile]) { grid-template-columns: 1fr }
}

/* || DSM Gallery  */
	

.dsm-gallery-row--wrapper {
  user-select: none;
  gap: var(--gap, 1rem);
  width: 100%;
  --gallery-gap: 1rem;
  --gallery-duration: 60s;
}

.dsm-gallery-row {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--gallery-gap, 1rem);
  animation: scroll var(--gallery-duration, 60s) linear infinite;
}

.dsm-gallery-row--wrapper:nth-child(odd)  .dsm-gallery-row {
      animation-name: scroll-reverse;
}

@keyframes scroll {
  from {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
  to {
    transform: translateX(calc(-100% - var(--gallery-gap, 1rem)));
  }
}

@keyframes scroll-reverse {
  from {
    transform: translateX(calc(-100% - var(--gallery-gap, 1rem)));
  }
  to {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}


/* Pause on hover */


.dsm-gallery-row--wrapper:hover .dsm-gallery-row {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

/* Respect reduced motion preferences */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .dsm-gallery-row {
    animation: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
.dsm-gallery-row--wrapper {
  --gallery-gap: 0.5rem;
}    
}

<script>
(function() {
  const BUTTON_SHOW_DELAY = 800;
  const VIDEO_INITIAL_DELAY = 2500;
  const HIDE_BUTTON_THRESHOLD = 0.95;
  const DESKTOP_MIN_WIDTH = 1024;
  
  const controlBtn = document.querySelector('.video-motion-control');
  const video = document.querySelector('.elementor-video');
  
  if (!controlBtn || !video) {
    console.warn('Video motion control: button or video element not found');
    return;
  }
  
  const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  let isButtonVisible = false;
  
  function isDesktop() {
    return window.innerWidth >= DESKTOP_MIN_WIDTH;
  }
 
  function init() {
    if (prefersReducedMotion) {
      video.pause();
      video.removeAttribute('autoplay');
      controlBtn.remove();
      return;
    }
    
    video.pause();
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      controlBtn.classList.add('visible');
      isButtonVisible = true;
    }, BUTTON_SHOW_DELAY);
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      video.play();
    }, VIDEO_INITIAL_DELAY);
    
    if (isDesktop()) {
      setupScrollTriggerListener();
    }
  }
  
  function setupScrollTriggerListener() {
    if (!window.ScrollTrigger) return;
    
    function checkProgress() {
      const heroST = ScrollTrigger.getById('heroScroll');
      
      if (heroST) {
        const progress = heroST.progress || 0;
        
        if (progress >= HIDE_BUTTON_THRESHOLD) {
          hideButton();
        } else if (progress < HIDE_BUTTON_THRESHOLD) {
          showButton();
        }
      }
      
      requestAnimationFrame(checkProgress);
    }
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      requestAnimationFrame(checkProgress);
    }, 500);
  }
  
  function showButton() {
    if (!isButtonVisible) {
      controlBtn.classList.add('visible');
      isButtonVisible = true;
    }
  }
  
  function hideButton() {
    if (isButtonVisible) {
      controlBtn.classList.remove('visible');
      isButtonVisible = false;
    }
  }
  
  function toggleVideo() {
    if (video.paused) {
      video.play();
      controlBtn.classList.remove('is-paused');
      controlBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Pause video');
      controlBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    } else {
      video.pause();
      controlBtn.classList.add('is-paused');
      controlBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Play video');
      controlBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    }
  }
  
  controlBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleVideo);
  controlBtn.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleVideo();
    }
  });
  
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
  
  window.VideoMotionControl = {
    pause: () => {
      if (!video.paused) {
        video.pause();
        controlBtn.classList.add('is-paused');
        controlBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Play video');
        controlBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
      }
    },
    play: () => {
      if (video.paused) {
        video.play();
        controlBtn.classList.remove('is-paused');
        controlBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Pause video');
        controlBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      }
    },
    toggle: toggleVideo
  };
})();

data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="theme-post-content.default"><div class="elementor-widget-container"><h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Is it easy to create a website in 2026 (with or without AI)?</strong></h3><p class="wp-block-paragraph">It’s a lot easier today. Elementor is a user-friendly website builder that offers a visual drag-and-drop Editor, enabling you to create a website in just a few clicks, with no prior coding knowledge required. It offers built-in AI tools for site planning, copywriting, image creation, and code generation, allowing you to customize your websites more efficiently. You can go from idea to a personalized website or update an existing website with a new site structure, performance optimizations, and new pages, faster than before. Then you can refine the website design visually with pixel-perfect precision with the Elementor Editor.</p><hr class="wp-block-separator has-text-color has-alpha-channel-opacity has-background is-style-default" style="margin-top:3.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem;background-color:#d1d1d1;color:#d1d1d1"/><h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>How do I create a professional website with a website builder with AI capabilities?</strong></h3><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Start by using the AI Site Planner to plan your entire website, generating a brief, sitemap, and wireframes. Then open the drag-and-drop website builder to design pages, add contact forms, and connect the third-party integrations you need. Publish on Elementor’s managed web hosting and connect your own domain name, or alternatively, you can use your own hosting provider. </p><hr class="wp-block-separator has-text-color has-alpha-channel-opacity has-background is-style-default" style="margin-top:3.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem;background-color:#d1d1d1;color:#d1d1d1"/><h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Can I create a website without knowing how to code or design?</strong></h3><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. The Editor’s drag-and-drop interface, website templates, and AI capabilities mean you can create your own website or business websites for clients and easily customize layouts, sections, and web pages with your own images and your own text, without any coding knowledge. Developers can still add advanced functionality and custom code when needed. Or use Elementor’s AI tools to create code for custom widgets and components, elevating website designs for any business industry.</p><hr class="wp-block-separator has-text-color has-alpha-channel-opacity has-background is-style-default" style="margin-top:3.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem;background-color:#d1d1d1;color:#d1d1d1"/><p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Should I use a no-code website builder or hire a web developer?</strong></p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">You can use a no-code website builder to launch professional websites quickly. Hire a professional for more complicated business websites, custom integrations, or when you want to add advanced functionality at scale. Elementor enables both first-time builders and professional web creators to work on one platform and leverage AI tools to enhance website functionality and performance. </p><hr class="wp-block-separator has-text-color has-alpha-channel-opacity has-background is-style-default" style="margin-top:3.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem;background-color:#d1d1d1;color:#d1d1d1"/><p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>How long does it take to build a website with AI in 2026?</strong></p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">With AI planning, you can go from concept to wireframe in 20 minutes, then complete styling and content in hours. Timelines vary by scope, depending on whether it’s single-page sites or robust enterprise-scale business websites, which would take longer. AI accelerates the sitemap, layout, copy, and image steps, but you still need to review and fine-tune to ensure consistency with your brand.</p><hr class="wp-block-separator has-text-color has-alpha-channel-opacity has-background is-style-default" style="margin-top:3.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem;background-color:#d1d1d1;color:#d1d1d1"/><p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>How do I create a brand identity and logo using a website builder with AI capabilities?</strong></p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Start with generating professional sitemaps and wireframes in minutes using AI Site Planner. Next, apply brand colors and fonts to the color palette within your generated wireframes. Moreover, use Elementor AI’s logo generation tool to generate professional logos. </p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Elementor AI tools can also serve as AI writers for content, taglines, and microcopy. You can use Elementor’s AI image creation tool to generate on-brand images with the brand color palette.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-elementor-type="loop-item" class="wp-block-paragraph">With Elementor One, you can build, optimize, and manage websites at scale. The One capabilities enable you to optimize images, boost accessibility, plan sites, improve email deliverability, access native AI tools to generate code, layout, images, and content, and much more.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">One focuses on delivering a unified workflow for critical site needs, offering maximum value and predictable cost via a single subscription and providing operational efficiency for professionals and agencies.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">The single subscription features a flexible, shared credit system that can be used across all included products, offering multi-site users flexibility and control, making it one of the best website builders on the market and boosting your website design capabilities.</p><hr class="wp-block-separator has-text-color has-alpha-channel-opacity has-background is-style-default" style="margin-top:3.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem;background-color:#d1d1d1;color:#d1d1d1"/><h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>What types of high-performance websites can I create with the Elementor website builder?</strong></h3><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Everything from landing pages and blogs to more complex websites, such as membership sites, portfolios, and online stores, that convert. With WooCommerce, you can start selling online, add products, and use eCommerce tools, all within the Elementor website builder’s drag-and-drop Editor.</p><hr class="wp-block-separator has-text-color has-alpha-channel-opacity has-background is-style-default" style="margin-top:3.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem;background-color:#d1d1d1;color:#d1d1d1"/><h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Can I use 3rd-party plugins and AI apps with the website builder?</strong></h3><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. The Elementor website builder is designed for WordPress web creators and provides extensive support for integrations. You can extend your site with any of the other 60,000-plus plugins in the WordPress repo, and essentially integrate almost anything you want due to its open-source nature.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">You can enhance your business website with plugins for site optimization, performance, security, accessibility, code tools, and even analytics tools. </p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">You can also boost your marketing and reach by connecting CRMs and plugins for forms, email campaigns, and booking systems. </p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">These integrations enhance your website builder with AI-powered features and workflow automation. Just ensure you review each add-on’s compatibility and performance impact.</p><hr class="wp-block-separator has-text-color has-alpha-channel-opacity has-background is-style-default" style="margin-top:3.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem;background-color:#d1d1d1;color:#d1d1d1"/><p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Does the website builder support marketing and email?</strong></p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. Elementor offers built-in marketing tools, such as popups and forms, to enhance marketing campaigns for any business, whether it sells products, services, or hosts in-person events. For transactional email, Elementor’s Site Mailer replaces SMTP, adds delivery logs, and improves reliability. You can also run social media marketing and connect social media platforms. </p><hr class="wp-block-separator has-text-color has-alpha-channel-opacity has-background is-style-default" style="margin-top:3.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem;background-color:#d1d1d1;color:#d1d1d1"/><p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>How can I connect a custom domain to my new website?</strong></p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">You can now purchase and connect your custom domain directly from Elementor. No DNS guesswork, no third-party juggling.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Simply claim an available domain name that fits your brand, <a href="https://elementor.com/help/connect-your-domain-to-a-website/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">assign it in your site settings</a>, and your website goes live on your perfect address in just a few clicks. </p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">With Elementor’s built-in domain setup, you can plan, create, and publish your business website in one place, so you can launch your business function initializeFAQ() {
  const faqTitles = document.querySelectorAll('.dsm-faq--title');

  if (faqTitles.length > 0) {
    faqTitles.forEach((title, index) => {
      const contentId = `faq-content-${index + 1}`;
      const content = title.nextElementSibling;

      title.classList.toggle('active', false);
      title.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      title.setAttribute('aria-controls', contentId);
      title.removeAttribute('aria-selected');
      content.id = contentId;
      content.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

      updateContentLinksTabIndex(content, false);

      title.addEventListener('click', () => {
        toggleFaq(title);
      });

      title.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
          event.preventDefault();
          toggleFaq(title);
        }
      });
    });
  }
}

function toggleFaq(title) {
  const isExpanded = title.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
  const content = document.getElementById(title.getAttribute('aria-controls'));

  title.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !isExpanded);
  content.setAttribute('aria-hidden', isExpanded);
  title.classList.toggle('active', !isExpanded);

  updateContentLinksTabIndex(content, !isExpanded);
}

function updateContentLinksTabIndex(content, isVisible) {
  const linksInContent = content.querySelectorAll('a, button, input, textarea, select');
  
  linksInContent.forEach(link => {
    if (isVisible) {
      link.removeAttribute('tabindex');
    } else {
      link.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    }
  });
}

window.addEventListener('load', initializeFAQ);

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const faqTitles = document.querySelectorAll('.dsm-faq--title');
    
    faqTitles.forEach((title, index) => {
        const questionTitle = title.querySelector('.elementor-heading-title').textContent;
        
        title.setAttribute('role', 'button')
        title.setAttribute('data-gtm-event_name', 'element_click');
        title.setAttribute('data-gtm-type', 'ui');
        title.setAttribute('data-gtm-section', 'faq');
        title.setAttribute('data-gtm-outcome', 'opening a faq');
        title.setAttribute('data-gtm-link_text', questionTitle);
        
        title.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const currentLevel2Value = title.getAttribute('data-gtm-outcome');
            const newLevel2Value = (currentLevel2Value === 'closing a faq') ? 'opening a faq' : 'closing a faq';
            title.setAttribute('data-gtm-outcome', newLevel2Value);
        });
    });
});
</script></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-766e6de elementor-widget__width-inherit elementor-widget elementor-widget-html" data-id="766e6de" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="html.default"><div class="elementor-widget-container"><style>.dsm-faq .e-loop-item:last-child > .e-parent{

<script>
(function() {
    'use strict';
    
    /**
     * Updates the text content of '.active-language a' to use the value from its 'lang' attribute
     */
    function updateActiveLanguageText() {
        // Check if weglot-container exists, exit if not
        const weglotContainer = document.querySelector('#lang-switcher .weglot-container');
        if (!weglotContainer) {
            return;
        }
        
        const activeLanguageLink = document.querySelector('#lang-switcher .active-language a');
        
        if (activeLanguageLink) {
            const langValue = activeLanguageLink.getAttribute('lang');
            
            if (langValue) {
                activeLanguageLink.textContent = langValue;
            }
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Try to update with retry mechanism
     */
    function tryUpdate() {
        updateActiveLanguageText();
        
        // If elements weren't found, retry after a delay
        const weglotContainer = document.querySelector('#lang-switcher .weglot-container');
        const activeLanguageLink = document.querySelector('#lang-switcher .active-language a');
        
        if (!weglotContainer || !activeLanguageLink) {
            // Retry after 500ms, then 1000ms, then 2000ms
            setTimeout(updateActiveLanguageText, 150);
            setTimeout(updateActiveLanguageText, 300);
            setTimeout(updateActiveLanguageText, 600);
        }
    }
    
    // Run on DOMContentLoaded with delay
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            setTimeout(tryUpdate, 100);
        });
    } else {
        // DOM is already loaded
        setTimeout(tryUpdate, 100);
    }
    
    // Also try on window load
    window.addEventListener('load', function() {
        setTimeout(updateActiveLanguageText, 100);
    });
})();

<script>
/**
 * Elementor.com WebMCP tools (read-only).
 *
 * Registers tools that let browser agents answer questions about Elementor's products, plans,
 * roadmap, legal documents and resources. All data is read live from:
 *   - /llms-full.txt products, FAQ, resource hubs, legal links (falls back to /llms.txt; edit these files to change answers)
 *   - /pricing.md   plans and prices
 *   - /wp-json/wp/v2 (public REST API) roadmap, legal documents, site search
 *
 * Does nothing in browsers without WebMCP support. Every tool is marked readOnlyHint: true.
 * Each tool is registered with its own literal registerTool() call so audits and crawlers can read
 * the definitions from the source. Keep names, descriptions and schemas in sync with public-mcp-server.php.
 * For testing in any browser: await ElementorWebMCP.run('get_roadmap', { status: 'Coming next' })
 */
(function () {
	'use strict';

	var BASE = ( typeof location !== 'undefined' && location.origin ) ? location.origin : 'https://elementor.com';
	var API = BASE + '/wp-json/wp/v2';
	var LLMS_URL = BASE + '/llms.txt';
	var LLMS_FULL_URL = BASE + '/llms-full.txt';
	var PRICING_URL = BASE + '/pricing.md';
	var ROADMAP_PAGE = BASE + '/roadmap/';
	var MAX_TEXT = 20000;

	/* ---------- helpers ---------- */

	function fetchText( url, signal ) {
		// same-origin (the default) so protected environments such as a staging site behind an access
		// gate keep working. WordPress ignores its login cookie on REST requests without a nonce,
		// so the REST API still answers these as anonymous.
		return fetch( url, { signal: signal, credentials: 'same-origin' } ).then( function ( res ) {
			if ( ! res.ok ) {
				throw new Error( 'Request failed (' + res.status + '): ' + url );
			}
			return res.text();
		} );
	}

	function fetchJSON( url, signal ) {
		return fetchText( url, signal ).then( JSON.parse );
	}

	function decodeEntities( text ) {
		var named = { amp: '&', lt: '<', gt: '>', quot: '"', apos: "'", nbsp: ' ' };
		return String( text )
			.replace( /&#(\d+);/g, function ( _, n ) { return String.fromCharCode( parseInt( n, 10 ) ); } )
			.replace( /&#x([0-9a-f]+);/gi, function ( _, n ) { return String.fromCharCode( parseInt( n, 16 ) ); } )
			.replace( /&([a-z]+);/gi, function ( m, n ) { return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call( named, n.toLowerCase() ) ? named[ n.toLowerCase() ] : m; } );
	}

	function htmlToText( html ) {
		return decodeEntities(
			String( html || '' )
				.replace( /<(script|style)[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi, ' ' )
				.replace( /<li[^>]*>/gi, '\n- ' )
				.replace( /<\/(p|div|h[1-6]|li|ul|ol|tr|table|section)>|<br\s*\/?>|<hr[^>]*>/gi, '\n' )
				.replace( /<[^>]+>/g, '' )
		)
			.replace( /[ \t\u00a0]+/g, ' ' )
			.replace( /\n\s*\n\s*/g, '\n\n' )
			.trim();
	}

	// Return one part of a long text. If more remains, next_start tells the agent where to continue.
	function page( full, start ) {
		var from = clampInt( start, 0, full.length, 0 );
		var to = Math.min( full.length, from + MAX_TEXT );
		var part = { total_length: full.length, start: from, text: full.slice( from, to ) };
		if ( to < full.length ) {
			part.next_start = to;
		}
		return part;
	}

	function norm( s ) {
		return String( s || '' ).toLowerCase().replace( /[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ' ).trim();
	}

	function matches( query, haystack ) {
		var words = norm( query ).split( ' ' ).filter( Boolean );
		var h = norm( haystack );
		return words.every( function ( w ) { return h.indexOf( w ) !== -1; } );
	}

	function clampInt( value, min, max, fallback ) {
		var n = parseInt( value, 10 );
		if ( isNaN( n ) ) {
			return fallback;
		}
		return Math.min( max, Math.max( min, n ) );
	}

	/* ---------- llms.txt parsing ---------- */

	var LINK_RE = /\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?:\/\/[^)\s]+)\)/g;

	// Supported layouts (old and new llms.txt / llms-full.txt):
	//   ## ...Products...  then "### Product" + URL line + description, or "### Category" then
	//   "#### Product" + "URL: https://..." line + description, or "- **Name** — URL — description" bullets.
	//   ## Frequently Asked...  "**Question?**" followed by answer lines.
	//   ## Resource... / Company... / Trust... / Program... / Agent resources: markdown links.
	//   ## Legal...  markdown links.
	// Bold markers in headings ("## **Company**") are ignored.
	function headingText( line, hashes ) {
		return line.slice( hashes ).replace( /\*\*/g, '' ).trim();
	}

	function parseLlms( md ) {
		var data = { products: [], faq: [], resources: [], legal: [] };
		var lines = String( md ).split( /\r?\n/ );
		var h2 = '';
		var h3 = '';
		var product = null;
		var faqItem = null;

		function closeProduct() {
			if ( product ) {
				product.description = product.description.join( ' ' ).trim();
				// A heading with no URL and no text of its own is a category, not a product.
				if ( product.url || product.description ) {
					data.products.push( product );
				}
				product = null;
			}
		}
		function closeFaq() {
			if ( faqItem ) {
				faqItem.answer = faqItem.answer.join( ' ' ).trim();
				data.faq.push( faqItem );
				faqItem = null;
			}
		}

		lines.forEach( function ( raw ) {
			var line = raw.trim();
			var m;

			if ( /^####\s+/.test( line ) ) {
				closeProduct();
				if ( /product/i.test( h2 ) ) {
					product = { name: headingText( line, 4 ), url: '', description: [] };
					if ( h3 ) {
						product.category = h3;
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			if ( /^###\s+/.test( line ) ) {
				closeProduct();
				h3 = headingText( line, 3 );
				if ( /product/i.test( h2 ) && ! /^themes/i.test( h3 ) ) {
					product = { name: h3, url: '', description: [] };
				}
				return;
			}
			if ( /^##\s+/.test( line ) ) {
				closeProduct();
				closeFaq();
				h2 = headingText( line, 2 );
				h3 = '';
				return;
			}
			if ( line === '---' ) {
				closeProduct();
				closeFaq();
				return;
			}

			if ( /product/i.test( h2 ) ) {
				m = line.match( /^-\s+\*\*(.+?)\*\*\s*[—-]\s*(https?:\/\/\S+)\s*[—-]\s*(.+)$/ );
				if ( m ) {
					closeProduct();
					data.products.push( { name: m[ 1 ], url: m[ 2 ], description: m[ 3 ].trim() } );
					return;
				}
				if ( product ) {
					m = line.match( /^(?:URL:\s*)?(https?:\/\/[^\s)]+)/i );
					if ( ! product.url && m && ( /^URL:/i.test( line ) || /^https?:\/\/\S+$/.test( line ) ) ) {
						product.url = m[ 1 ];
					} else if ( line ) {
						product.description.push( line );
					}
				}
				return;
			}

			if ( /frequently asked/i.test( h2 ) ) {
				m = line.match( /^\*\*(.+)\*\*$/ );
				if ( m ) {
					closeFaq();
					faqItem = { question: m[ 1 ], answer: [] };
				} else if ( faqItem && line ) {
					faqItem.answer.push( line );
				}
				return;
			}

			var isLegal = /^legal/i.test( h2 );
			var isResource = /resource|company|trust|program/i.test( h2 );
			if ( ( isLegal || isResource ) && line ) {
				var found = [];
				LINK_RE.lastIndex = 0;
				while ( ( m = LINK_RE.exec( line ) ) !== null ) {
					found.push( { name: m[ 1 ], url: m[ 2 ], end: m.index + m[ 0 ].length } );
				}
				found.forEach( function ( link ) {
					var desc = '';
					if ( found.length === 1 ) {
						var rest = line.slice( link.end ).match( /^\s*:\s*(.+)$/ );
						desc = rest ? rest[ 1 ].trim() : '';
					}
					var item = { name: link.name, url: link.url, category: h3 || h2 };
					if ( desc ) {
						item.description = desc;
					}
					( isLegal ? data.legal : data.resources ).push( item );
				} );
			}
		} );

		closeProduct();
		closeFaq();
		return data;
	}

	var llmsCache = null;
	function getLlms( signal ) {
		if ( ! llmsCache ) {
			// llms-full.txt has the full product descriptions, FAQ and legal links; llms.txt is only an index.
			llmsCache = fetchText( LLMS_FULL_URL, signal )
				.catch( function () { return fetchText( LLMS_URL, signal ); } )
				.then( parseLlms )
				.catch( function ( err ) {
					llmsCache = null;
					throw err;
				} );
		}
		return llmsCache;
	}

	/* ---------- tool handlers ---------- */

	// What each tool does. Names, descriptions and input schemas live in the registerTool() calls below.
	var handlers = {
		get_products: function ( args, opts ) {
			return getLlms( opts && opts.signal ).then( function ( data ) {
				if ( args && args.product ) {
					var hits = data.products.filter( function ( p ) { return matches( args.product, p.name ); } );
					if ( ! hits.length ) {
						hits = data.products.filter( function ( p ) { return matches( args.product, p.name + ' ' + p.description ); } );
					}
					if ( ! hits.length ) {
						return {
							error: 'No product matched "' + args.product + '".',
							available_products: data.products.map( function ( p ) { return p.name; } )
						};
					}
					return { products: hits, pricing: 'Call get_plans_and_pricing for prices and plan comparisons.' };
				}
				return {
					products: data.products.map( function ( p ) {
						var first = p.description.match( /^[\s\S]*?\.(?=\s|$)/ );
						return { name: p.name, url: p.url, summary: first ? first[ 0 ] : p.description };
					} )
				};
			} );
		},
		get_plans_and_pricing: function ( args, opts ) {
			return fetchText( PRICING_URL, opts && opts.signal ).then( function ( text ) {
				var part = page( text, args && args.start );
				part.source = PRICING_URL;
				return part;
			} );
		},
		get_faq: function ( args, opts ) {
			return getLlms( opts && opts.signal ).then( function ( data ) {
				var list = data.faq;
				if ( args && args.query ) {
					list = list.filter( function ( f ) { return matches( args.query, f.question + ' ' + f.answer ); } );
				}
				return { faq: list };
			} );
		},
		get_roadmap: function ( args, opts ) {
			var signal = opts && opts.signal;
			args = args || {};
			return Promise.all( [
				fetchJSON( API + '/roadmap-status?per_page=100&_fields=id,name', signal ),
				fetchJSON( API + '/roadmap-tag?per_page=100&_fields=id,name', signal )
			] ).then( function ( lists ) {
				var statuses = lists[ 0 ];
				var tags = lists[ 1 ];
				var statusById = {};
				var tagById = {};
				statuses.forEach( function ( s ) { statusById[ s.id ] = decodeEntities( s.name ); } );
				tags.forEach( function ( t ) { tagById[ t.id ] = decodeEntities( t.name ); } );

				var query = '&per_page=' + clampInt( args.limit, 1, 50, 20 );
				if ( args.status ) {
					var s = statuses.filter( function ( x ) { return norm( x.name ) === norm( args.status ); } )[ 0 ];
					if ( ! s ) {
						return { error: 'Unknown status "' + args.status + '".', valid_statuses: statuses.map( function ( x ) { return decodeEntities( x.name ); } ) };
					}
					query += '&roadmap-status=' + s.id;
				}
				if ( args.tag ) {
					var t = tags.filter( function ( x ) { return norm( x.name ) === norm( args.tag ); } )[ 0 ];
					if ( ! t ) {
						return { error: 'Unknown tag "' + args.tag + '".', valid_tags: tags.map( function ( x ) { return decodeEntities( x.name ); } ) };
					}
					query += '&roadmap-tag=' + t.id;
				}

				return fetchJSON( API + '/roadmap?_fields=id,date,title,content,roadmap-status,roadmap-tag' + query, signal ).then( function ( items ) {
					return {
						roadmap_page: ROADMAP_PAGE,
						entries: items.map( function ( i ) {
							return {
								title: htmlToText( i.title && i.title.rendered ),
								date: i.date,
								status: ( i[ 'roadmap-status' ] || [] ).map( function ( id ) { return statusById[ id ]; } ).filter( Boolean ),
								tags: ( i[ 'roadmap-tag' ] || [] ).map( function ( id ) { return tagById[ id ]; } ).filter( Boolean ),
								description: htmlToText( i.content && i.content.rendered )
							};
						} )
					};
				} );
			} );
		},
		find_legal_documents: function ( args, opts ) {
			var signal = opts && opts.signal;
			var q = args && args.query ? String( args.query ) : '';
			var rest = API + '/legal?per_page=20&_fields=slug,title,link,modified' + ( q ? '&search=' + encodeURIComponent( q ) : '' );
			return Promise.all( [ getLlms( signal ), fetchJSON( rest, signal ) ] ).then( function ( res ) {
				var data = res[ 0 ];
				var seen = {};
				var docs = [];
				function add( doc ) {
					if ( ! seen[ doc.url ] ) {
						seen[ doc.url ] = true;
						docs.push( doc );
					}
				}
				data.legal
					.filter( function ( l ) { return ! q || matches( q, l.name ); } )
					.forEach( function ( l ) { add( { title: l.name, url: l.url } ); } );
				res[ 1 ].forEach( function ( d ) {
					add( { title: htmlToText( d.title && d.title.rendered ), url: d.link, slug: d.slug, updated: d.modified } );
				} );
				var center = data.resources.filter( function ( r ) { return /legal center/i.test( r.name ); } )[ 0 ];
				return { legal_center: center ? center.url : BASE + '/legal-center/', documents: docs };
			} );
		},
		get_legal_document: function ( args, opts ) {
			var ref = String( ( args && args.document ) || '' ).trim();
			var slug = ref.replace( /[?#].*$/, '' ).replace( /\/+$/, '' ).split( '/' ).pop();
			if ( ! slug ) {
				return Promise.resolve( { error: 'Pass a slug such as "privacy" or a document URL.' } );
			}
			var url = API + '/legal?slug=' + encodeURIComponent( slug ) + '&_fields=title,link,modified,content';
			return fetchJSON( url, opts && opts.signal ).then( function ( items ) {
				if ( ! items.length ) {
					return { error: 'No legal document found for "' + ref + '".', hint: 'Call find_legal_documents to list available documents.' };
				}
				var d = items[ 0 ];
				var part = page( htmlToText( d.content && d.content.rendered ), args && args.start );
				part.title = htmlToText( d.title && d.title.rendered );
				part.url = d.link;
				part.updated = d.modified;
				return part;
			} );
		},
		list_resources: function ( args, opts ) {
			return getLlms( opts && opts.signal ).then( function ( data ) {
				var list = data.resources;
				if ( args && args.category ) {
					list = list.filter( function ( r ) { return matches( args.category, r.category ); } );
				}
				var categories = [];
				data.resources.forEach( function ( r ) {
					if ( categories.indexOf( r.category ) === -1 ) {
						categories.push( r.category );
					}
				} );
				return { categories: categories, resources: list };
			} );
		},
		search_elementor: function ( args, opts ) {
			var q = String( ( args && args.query ) || '' ).trim();
			if ( ! q ) {
				return Promise.resolve( { error: 'Pass a search query.' } );
			}
			var url = API + '/search?search=' + encodeURIComponent( q ) + '&per_page=' + clampInt( args.limit, 1, 20, 10 ) + '&_fields=title,url,subtype';
			return fetchJSON( url, opts && opts.signal ).then( function ( items ) {
				return {
					results: items.map( function ( i ) {
						return { title: htmlToText( i.title ), url: i.url, type: i.subtype };
					} )
				};
			} );
		}
	};

	/* ---------- run ---------- */

	function run( name, args, opts ) {
		var handler = handlers[ name ];
		if ( ! handler ) {
			return Promise.resolve( JSON.stringify( { error: 'Unknown tool "' + name + '".' } ) );
		}
		if ( typeof args === 'string' ) {
			try {
				args = JSON.parse( args ); // Older Chrome versions passed arguments as a JSON string.
			} catch ( e ) {
				args = {};
			}
		}
		return Promise.resolve()
			.then( function () { return handler( args || {}, opts || {} ); } )
			.then( function ( result ) { return JSON.stringify( result ); } )
			.catch( function ( err ) {
				return JSON.stringify( { error: err && err.message ? err.message : 'Tool failed.', hint: 'Try again, or see ' + BASE + '/llms.txt' } );
			} );
	}

	var root = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis;
	root.ElementorWebMCP = { tools: Object.keys( handlers ), run: run, parseLlms: parseLlms, htmlToText: htmlToText };

	/* ---------- register ---------- */

	var hasDocumentApi = typeof document !== 'undefined' && !! document.modelContext && typeof document.modelContext.registerTool === 'function';
	var hasNavigatorApi = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !! navigator.modelContext && typeof navigator.modelContext.registerTool === 'function';
	if ( ! hasDocumentApi ) {
		if ( ! hasNavigatorApi ) {
			return;
		}
		// Older compatibility fallback only: browsers that expose the API on navigator.
		try {
			Object.defineProperty( document, 'modelContext', { value: navigator.modelContext, configurable: true } );
		} catch ( e ) {
			return;
		}
	}

	// One failed registration must not stop the others.
	function safely( register ) {
		try {
			Promise.resolve( register() ).catch( function () {} );
		} catch ( e ) {}
	}

	safely( function () {
		return document.modelContext.registerTool( {
			name: 'get_products',
			description: 'List Elementor products (the free plugin, Pro, Website Builder, Elementor One, Hosting, AI, Angie, Image Optimizer, Site Mailer, Ally, and more) with a description and link for each. Pass "product" to get details for one product. Use get_plans_and_pricing for prices and plan comparisons.',
			inputSchema: {
				type: 'object',
				properties: {
					product: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional product name, for example "Elementor Pro" or "Hosting".' }
				}
			},
			annotations: { readOnlyHint: true, untrustedContentHint: false },
			execute: function ( args, opts ) { return run( 'get_products', args, opts ); }
		} );
	} );

	safely( function () {
		return document.modelContext.registerTool( {
			name: 'get_plans_and_pricing',
			description: 'Get Elementor\'s current plans and prices (Markdown), to compare plans and products or explain what each plan includes. The document is returned in parts: if the response has "next_start", call again with start set to that value to read the next part.',
			inputSchema: {
				type: 'object',
				properties: {
